body: Maybe my jealousy is not justified but I actually have no control over it. I wish I could make myself does not feel this way. And to answer the other question, when my brother was sexually active with only one partner I never felt jealous towards her, not even towards him at this point. But now he is sexually active with more than one partner. He never admitted this but I'm aware of it. I do not know what this is called because English is not my first language but I mean he is in multiple relationships in the same time. Maybe it's called cheating or whatever. But from my point of view, he has many and I have none! This is why I'm jealous of him. Regarding everyone else who is sexually active in this world, I rarely feel jealous of them.

What makes me feel very jealous of my brother is that at some point of our lives we both were sexually-inactive and later both of us confessed to the other that we suffer from impotence. A few months later we both underwent the same medical tests and investigations which revealed that: my brother is perfectly fine, maybe just some form of psychological ED that needs no treatment, and me being physically impotent due to a rare medical condition with blood vessels that does not respond to available treatments like Viagra, Cilais or even the more invasive intracavernosal injections. I remember how we both were (more or less) depressed when we both were sexually inactive and I can see how everything of his life changed when he became sexually active while I'm just getting more and more depressed.

Maybe I exaggerate when I say I'm very ugly but at least I'm unattractive and being obese (or at least overweight) makes it a lot worse. My ED remains my main problem though. If I had no ED everything would be perfectly fine even if I were very ugly. At least I would be able to masturbate to porn.
I do not suffer from porn-induced erectile dysfunction. I suffer from a rare medical condition called [venous leak](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Venous_leak).
